Starting Balances — Suppliers

When transitioning to Manager.io from another accounting system or starting with existing supplier balances, it's important to record the amounts you owe to your suppliers as starting balances. This ensures your accounts payable and overall financial records are accurate from the start.

To set up starting balances for your suppliers, follow these steps:

  1. Navigate to the Suppliers tab on the left side of the Manager.io interface.

  2. Click on the Starting Balances - Suppliers option. This will open the screen where you can manage your suppliers' starting balances.

  3. Click the New Starting Balance button at the top of the screen.

    SuppliersNewStartingBalance

  4. Fill out the Starting Balance form for the supplier:

    • Select the Supplier: Choose the supplier you want to record a starting balance for.
    • Enter Invoice Details: If there are outstanding invoices, enter the invoice numbers, dates, and amounts.
    • Specify the Total Amount Owed: If you owe a balance that isn't tied to specific invoices, enter the total amount.

  5. Save the starting balance by clicking the Create button at the bottom of the form.

For detailed instructions on completing the Starting Balance form, refer to the Starting Balance for Supplier Form Guide.

Note: Accurate starting balances are crucial for maintaining the integrity of your accounts payable. Double-check all entries to ensure they match your previous accounting records or supplier statements.
